jobgether-jobgether:lever:039cf483-6b04-.title: Google Cloud Delivery Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:039cf483-6b04-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in Spain. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes. Strong architectural thinking, problem-solving ability, documentation skills, and attention to implementation qual

jobgether-jobgether:lever:60ed1e9d-b191-.title: Sr. Manager, Performance Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:60ed1e9d-b191-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Manager, Performance Marketing based in United States. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a performance marketing engine from the ground up within a fast-growing B2B software environment. You’ll own the strategy and hands-on execution across paid media, SEO, AI-driven visibility, and conversion optimization. The role combines demand capture and demand creation, connecting every marketing investment to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You’ll work directly in advertising accounts and analytics while coordinating agencies, contractors, creative teams, and cross-functional partners. A major focus will be establishing scalable experimentation, measurement, attribution, and budget optimization practices. You’ll also help shape how financial advisors discover and evaluate an emerging AI-native technology category. This player-coach role offers substantial ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to build a team as investment and impact grow. Own the paid media strategy and execution across Google, Bing, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging advertising channels, continuously optimizing spend toward qualified pipeline and ROI. Audit and rebuild existing paid programs, eliminate inefficient spend, rebalance investment across channels, and develop an evergreen acquisition strategy. Manage the full buyer journey from discovery and education through conversion, ensuring paid programs effectively support both demand capture and demand creation. Lead SEO, AEO, and GEO initiatives , increasing visibility across traditional search engines and AI-driven discovery platforms such as AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity. Develop and execute SEO and AI-visibility roadmaps covering competitor pages, category opportunities, long-tail queries, and content optimized for AI discovery. Own conversion rate optimization , including landing pages, offers, conversion paths, and experimentation designed to improve acquisition and trial performance. Establish a structured test-and-learn program across creative formats, audiences, offers, messaging, and channels, using clear hypotheses and measurable outcomes. Partner with creative and growth teams to develop performance-focused assets and improve downstream conversion. Own channel-level measurement and reporting, including spend pacing, CPL, cost per opportunity, and pipeline generated per marketing dollar. Maintain strong UTM, attribution, and CRM reporting practices in partnership with Marketing Operations, ensuring budget decisions are based on reliable pipeline data rather than platform-level vanity metrics. Manage the performance marketing budget and external agencies or vendors, clearly communicating the financial rationale and expected trade-offs behind investment decisions. Test and evaluate new acquisition channels, scaling those that demonstrate meaningful results while quickly discontinuing those that do not. Build trusted weekly reporting that enables marketing and sales leadership to make informed decisions about channel performance and budget allocation. Develop the performance marketing team and operating model as investment and business scale increase. Requirements: 5+ years of experience owning performance marketing or paid acquisition within a high-growth B2B software environment, with hands-on expertise across Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Bing. Strong full-funnel measurement capabilities, including UTMs, attribution, CRM-connected reporting, Salesforce, pipeline measurement, and ROI optimization . Working knowledge of SEO and AI-era search visibility , including AEO/GEO and how buyers increasingly use AI-generated answers alongside traditional search. Proven experience with CRO and landing-page optimization , including testing pages, offers, audiences, and creative to deliver measurable conversion improvements. A demonstrated builder mentalit

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f3191284-5616-.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f3191284-5616-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer based in Brazil. This is a hands-on engineering opportunity focused on developing high-performance actuation and precision drive systems for advanced robotic applications. You will take ownership across the product lifecycle, from mechanical architecture and engineering analysis through CAD, prototyping, validation, and production readiness. The role combines deep mechanical engineering expertise with practical experimentation and iterative hardware development. You will work with advanced materials and manufacturing specialists to turn innovative technologies into reliable, manufacturable designs. Close collaboration with customer engineering teams will be essential to ensure successful mechanical, electrical, packaging, and control integration. The environment offers significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence how sophisticated robotic systems move and perform. It is an ideal role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex mechanical problems and seeing designs progress from concept to real-world hardware. Design compact, high-performance rotary and linear actuators , including harmonic or strain-wave, planetary, cycloidal, and other advanced drive architectures. Own mechanical and precision-drive designs throughout the development lifecycle, from concept and architecture through prototyping, validation, production readiness, and customer integration . Apply first-principles engineering, including kinematics, statics, dynamics, and materials science , to make sound architecture and design decisions. Compare alternative concepts through analytical calculations, engineering trade studies, simulations, and physical testing. Build, test, and refine prototypes to improve torque density, efficiency, durability, manufacturability, packaging, and overall performance . Collaborate with materials and manufacturing engineers to incorporate advanced materials and fabrication processes into practical mechanical solutions. Work directly with customer engineering teams to ensure drive systems meet mechanical, electrical, packaging, and control-interface requirements. Develop detailed 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, bills of materials, assembly documentation , and other manufacturing and integration documentation. Plan and execute verification testing, analyze results, identify root causes, and iterate designs based on real-world performance. Participate in technical design reviews and support design verification, system integration, and successful hardware deployment. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics , or a closely related engineering discipline. At least 3 years of professional experience designing electromechanical actuators, gear systems, precision drive mechanisms, or comparable mechanical systems. Strong understanding of kinematics, statics, dynamics, mechanical design principles, and materials behavior . Demonstrated knowledge of precision actuators, gearing, or mechanical power-transmission systems. Proficiency with modern 3D CAD software and commonly used mechanical simulation or engineering analysis tools. Hands-on experience building, machining, assembling, and testing mechanical or electromechanical prototypes . Ability to take mechanical concepts beyond CAD and contribute directly to physical validation, troubleshooting, and design iteration . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make engineering decisions based on calculations, testing, and data. Ability to work collaboratively across engineering disciplines and communicate effectively with technical stakeholders. southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:89ac07.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As a GTM Engineer on the Post-Sales team, you will build the infrastructure that powers how we retain and grow our customer base. Part systems architect and part customer intelligence platform, you will turn data from across the customer lifecycle into automated workflows that give engagement managers and account managers real leverage. Your work will directly shape how our Customer Success function scales. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build automated customer health scoring across the full book of business, synthesizing product usage, support signals, and engagement data into a single, reliable picture of each account - Design expansion signal detection for account managers that automatically surfaces accounts ready to grow, flagging patterns in usage, seat activity, and engagement that typically precede an upsell conversation - Automate recurring touchpoints across the customer lifecycle, including onboarding checklists, usage review summaries, and adoption nudges, so engagement managers can focus on the work that requires a human - Build renewal risk scoring that surfaces at-risk accounts 60 or more days before their renewal date, giving the team the time and context to intervene effectively - Generate business review materials automatically by pulling usage metrics, ROI data, and AI use case recommendations from multiple internal sources into a format teams can present immediately - Analyze call recordings and transcripts to identify AI use cases that map to each customer’s business, then automate the process of building and deploying those use cases at scale - Build routing logic for assigning new customers to the right team member at handoff, accounting for current workload, open renewals, domain expertise, and timezone alignment - Manufacture tools rather than operate them, building systems the post-sales team can run independently WHO YOU ARE - High-agency builder who can identify a problem in the customer lifecycle, scope a solution, and ship it without being closely managed - Technically fluent in Python or JavaScript, comfortable building data pipelines, integrating APIs, and working across tools like Gong, Salesforce, and n8n - AI-native thinker who defaults to automation and regularly experiments with agents, LLM APIs, and workflow frameworks - Pragmatic about build versus buy, knowing when to leverage existing infrastructure rather than rebuild it - Experience with post-sales, customer success, or account management operations - Comfortable reasoning about data at a statistical level; building signal detection and predictive models, not just moving records between systems - Familiar with tools like Gainsight, Gong, Salesforce, Dust, or similar customer-facing platforms - Systems thinker who sees how data moves through the customer lifecycle and builds with that full picture in mind - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and structuring your own roadmap LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. Outpatient-Centered Practice: Deliver outstanding care in a supportive environment focused on follow-ups and new patient consults. Consistent Patient Flow: See an average of 25–30 patients per day in a full clinic, with travel to nearby New Lenox and Morris locations . Collaborative Team Culture: Join a team of 8 full-time physicians and 3 experienced APPs who believe in shared knowledge and seamless patient care. Competitive Pay + Full Benefits: Receive a guaranteed base salary and a comprehensive benefits package designed to reward your dedication and skill. Why You’ll Love Joliet, IL Joliet offers a little bit of everything— suburban ease, small-town charm, and big-city access . Here’s what makes it a great place to live and work: Easy Living: Affordable housing, scenic trails, and family-friendly neighborhoods. Entertainment Hub: Catch a race at Chicagoland Speedway, enjoy concerts at the Rialto Square Theatre, or explore downtown’s growing dining scene. Close to Chicago: All the perks of the Windy City—world-class culture, food, and sports—just a short drive away. A Community That Cares: Joliet blends the convenience of modern living with the warmth of a close-knit community Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve.
